audit.why: Quinn's spike is levels 1-5 with Vault and Harrier procs; Vladimir's are level 6 and first item. Spike entries already say so.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[0] and early both say Blinding Assault 'nullifies your only damage source since Transfusion is your auto-reliant harass'.
audit.why: Transfusion is a targeted spell — Riot's text is 'Vladimir steals life from the target enemy' — so a blind does not stop it at all. The blind matters for your basic attacks and last-hitting, not for your damage pattern. What actually beats you early is range and cooldowns: Blinding Assault reaches 1025 on 11s at rank 1 against your 600-range Q, and Vault is a 675-range dash on 12s that leaps her back out to attack range after the trade, so chasing is free damage for her.
